title: Puppy in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='34' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#e0a869'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='87' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e0a869'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='87' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e0a869'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='25' fill='#c98a4b'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#5a3418'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 47.5 q-4 5 -8 2' fill='none' stroke='#5a3418' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 47.5 q4 5 8 2' fill='none' stroke='#5a3418' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
